projects.title: Hearo — At-Home Smart Ear Exam
projects.summary: A redesigned smart otoscope concept helps parents capture at-home ear images that clinicians can use.
projects.problem: Families often need professional clinic visits to examine possible ear infections.
projects.solution: The team developed an easier-to-use at-home ear imaging device designed for caregivers and clinician review.

projects.title: PedalSwap — Modular Guitar Effects System
projects.summary: A modular effects-pedal platform with interchangeable components offers musicians a flexible alternative to separate pedals.
projects.problem: Buying separate guitar pedals can be costly and makes experimenting with effects cumbersome.
projects.solution: Interchangeable effect components connect to a common pedal platform so musicians can experiment with configurations.

projects.title: DoorTix — Ticket-Purchasing Automation
projects.summary: An automated ticket-purchasing concept is designed to help fans find seats under user-defined price preferences.
projects.problem: Ticket purchasing can be difficult to navigate, with unpredictable prices and limited transparency.
projects.solution: A concierge-like tool aims to secure event tickets at prices specified by customers.

projects.title: Matareal — Mural Paint Estimation
projects.summary: A tool converts mural designs into estimates of required paint, reducing the time needed to plan large artwork.
projects.problem: Artists can spend significant time calculating paint amounts for mural projects.
projects.solution: The team built a paint estimation tool to support faster, more consistent mural planning.

projects.title: Convexity Electronics — Printed Circuit Board 3D Printer
projects.summary: An electronics 3D printer concept targets faster, more compact fabrication of printed circuit boards.
projects.problem: Conventional circuit-board manufacturing can have lead times and design constraints that slow prototyping.
projects.solution: The team developed a system for manufacturing 3D-printed circuit boards at scale.

projects.title: StrideLink — Wearable Gait Monitoring
projects.summary: A wearable aims to support remote gait analysis by measuring walking asymmetry.
projects.problem: Physical therapists may lack convenient data about how a patient's gait changes outside clinical settings.
projects.solution: The team proposed a wearable monitoring platform focused on walking asymmetry and remote observation.

projects.title: NeuroChamp — Pediatric Seizure Monitoring Headband
projects.summary: A concealed headband wearable was created to help monitor pediatric seizures continuously.
projects.problem: Some seizures are difficult for caregivers and educators to notice in everyday situations.
projects.solution: A discreet wearable monitoring concept was developed to support early recognition of events.

projects.title: PatchPals — Automated Wound-Care Foam Cutting
projects.summary: An AI-assisted wound-care tool aims to automate custom foam dressing cutting.
projects.problem: Preparing dressings for chronic wounds can require time-consuming manual cutting.
projects.solution: A system uses wound imagery and a guided cutting mechanism to make more precise foam shapes.
